$comment: Runtime witness that a `__declspec(...)` specifier is READ on the pe pair and that what it asks for reaches the emitted image. Until cycle P69 `__declspec(x)` was a predefined macro expanding to nothing: `align` was dropped, `thread` left one object shared by every thread, and the compiler said nothing either time. Sixteen arms, each scoring 1 when it holds, exit 26 + the count (42 when all hold): the five places cl's `align` lands (a leading one on a DEFINITION of a structure aligns the TYPE, also with no declarator; on a declaration that only refers to the structure, or after its body, the declared OBJECT; on a member; on a type alias it only RAISES; beside `_Alignas` the larger stands) read through `_Alignof`, `sizeof`, `offsetof` and the objects' addresses; `thread` read by a second thread writing a value the first must not see; the disagreeing pair `extern __declspec(thread) int v; int v = 1;` where the request yields and the object IS shared; and the modifiers that keep their plain meaning or are inert in an executable, in every form of the specifier (empty, white-space separated, comma separated, the one-underscore `_declspec`). pe only: the spelling does not exist for another object format, where it is refused by name (examples/c/declspec_is_refused_off_pe).
$measuredComment: MEASURED 2026-10-08 through `dssharness run probe-reference-cc`, on THIS source byte for byte (main.c, md5 a6ccdf3f59098d94a0051fe7f76d823f): cl 19.51 with `/std:clatest /W3` compiles it and the program exits 42 — all sixteen arms are cl's own answers — with ONE warning, C4996 at the use of `old_thing`, the line `expectWarnings` names for S_DeprecatedSymbolUsed. cl says nothing about the pair `extern __declspec(thread) int shared_after_all; int shared_after_all = 1;`: the S_AttributeIgnoredForDeclarationKind reported there is this compiler's own word about a request it does not apply. mingw-w64 gcc 13 cannot compile the file (it has no `<threads.h>`; measured cell by cell it also takes neither multi-modifier form, has no `_declspec`, and ignores `align` and `thread` with a warning each), so cl is the one reference this program runs on.
$commentWarnings: `expectWarnings` is exact over its two codes. S_AttributeIgnoredForDeclarationKind at the name of `int shared_after_all = 1;`: the thread-storage request of the prior declaration yields to a definition that does not repeat it — one report, and its being the ONLY report of that code is what says no other modifier of the file was ignored for its declaration kind. S_DeprecatedSymbolUsed at the one use of `old_thing`. `forbidDiagnostics`: H_NonVoidFunctionEndReachable is what the compiler says when `noreturn` is NOT seen on the two functions `ends_in_a_call_that_never_returns` ends in; S_UnknownAttribute and H_UnknownLinkageSpecifier are what it says of a modifier it has no row for — every modifier here has one.
$commentHostCoverage: WHAT EACH HOST ASSERTS OF THIS FILE (read in the two runners' sources, not assumed). On a WINDOWS host both corpus runners compile the pe pair, judge the diagnostics below and RUN the image, debug and release: the sixteen arms are read there and only there. On a host that is NOT Windows the in-process runner (tests/examples) still COMPILES the baseline arm for the pe pair and judges everything a compile can say — `expectWarnings` exact over its two codes with their positions, each `forbidDiagnostics` code absent, the image produced and not empty — and then stops at `runOn`: it spawns nothing, so the exit code (the sixteen arms) is NOT read, and the release arm is not even compiled (its verdict is the baseline's, 'compile not attempted: baseline arm did not run'). The CLI-subprocess runner (integrated_tests) binds one host-runnable target per manifest, so off Windows it never compiles this file at all. A defect that changes what the compiler SAYS about a `__declspec` request is therefore caught on every host; one that changes only what the request DOES to the image (an alignment, a thread's own copy) is caught on Windows alone — by this example — and on every host by the unit claims named next, which read the analyzer's own answers.
$commentRedOnDisable: WRITTEN, NOT READ — no mutation named here has been built and read, and this example is a corpus check, never a pin. The claims are the unit TESTs of tests/analysis/semantic/test_attribute_second_spelling.cpp (`AttributeSecondSpelling.SeveralModifiersInOneSpecifierAreEachHonoured`, `.AlignRaisesAnObjectOrAnAliasAndNeverLowersOne`, `.ALeadingAlignOnAStructureOrUnionDefinitionAlignsTheType`, `.AlignOnAMemberAndBesideAlignas`, `.ThreadGivesTheObjectThreadStorageWhereverItIsWritten`, `.AThreadRequestYieldsToADeclarationThatDoesNotMakeIt`, `.WithoutTheRowsAnswerADisagreeingThreadRequestIsRefused`, `.IsRefusedByNameOffTheFormatsItsRowNames`). Each mutation is to be an arm of tests/mutations/arms.registry, and proves its claim when that arm reads `passed`. Until then this is a PREDICTION from the code, not a measurement: with the specifier erased again (the retired predefine) arms 1 to 10 would fail, the deprecation warning disappear and H_NonVoidFunctionEndReachable be reported; with `align` read under the plain spelling's rules (`leadingDecoratesDefinitionOf`, `afterCompositeBody` or `onTypeAlias` dropped from the language document) arms 1 and 3, arm 5, or arm 7 would fail; with `threadStorage` dropped from the qualified linkage key arm 9 would fail; with `yieldsOnMismatch` dropped the build would be refused at `shared_after_all`.
